title: All In
source: YouTube Studio Audio Library (Dance and Electronic, Bright, 3:07); chosen by Luke 5 Oct 2026 (DEC-209); licence: YouTube Audio Library licence as shown in Studio - attribution requirement to be recorded from Cowork's README
notes: CHOSEN, NOT YET IN THE PRIVATE REPO (DEC-209, DEC-210): Claude in Cowork is downloading "All In" by Everet Almond in Luke's Chrome and storing it under assets/rtt-001/music/ in the private repo with its SHA-256 and a README (the RTT-003 method). Until Cowork gives the path and checksum, ready stays false and .github/workflows/rtt001_film.yml renders nothing.

Then Claude Code fills file, private_path, private_ref, sha256 and bytes from Cowork's message and README, records the licence and attribution in reference/rights_ledger.md, sets ready: true and pushes the workflow to render. The workflow fetches the file and stops unless its SHA-256 matches.

No loop: the track (3:07, about 187 s as listed in Studio) is longer than the film (5,529 frames = 184.3 s), so it plays once from its start, is cut to the film and fades out over the 10 s final table; mixed to about -16 LUFS integrated, true peak at most -1 dBTP (scripts/rtt_mix_music.sh, unchanged; the RTT-002/RTT-003 method, DEC-072/DEC-074). The workflow measures the real duration and stops if the track turns out shorter than the film.
